<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844" width="390" height="844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bgGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#9ADB7F"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6EA95C"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="8" stdDeviation="12" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.18"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bgGrad)"/>

  <!-- subtle decor -->
  <circle cx="335" cy="92" r="54" fill="#A5F59C" opacity="0.18"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="146" r="34" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>
  <circle cx="346" cy="314" r="24" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.10"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="622" r="52" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.08"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="21" y="25" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600">9:41</text>

    <g transform="translate(328,16)" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <circle cx="7" cy="8" r="4.5"></circle>
      <line x1="11" y1="12" x2="14" y2="15"></line>
    </g>
    <g transform="translate(348,15)">
      <rect x="0" y="4" width="24" height="11" rx="2.5" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
      <rect x="24.2" y="7.6" width="2" height="4" rx="0.8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
      <rect x="2" y="6" width="17" height="7" rx="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- top nav -->

    <g transform="translate(18,54)">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="354" height="52" rx="18" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.12" filter="url(#softShadow)"/>

  <g transform="translate(18,308)">
    <text x="0" y="0" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600">Placing</text>

      <text x="226" y="21" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="700">Classic</text>

  </g>

    <g filter="url(#shadow)">

  <!-- bottom nav -->
